serving.kill_switch: one committed flip of serving.active_source to "context" repoints every generated style at the boundaries fallback (`sig-ops basemap kill-switch`); the provider-side step — disabling the custom domain — is the operator's documented act

refresh.cadence: twice a year, or on a MapLibre/basemaps upgrade
steps: stream-download the archive verifying the index's b3sum
upload under the new versioned key basemap/<key>.pmtiles
record the key in host.served; the previous key keeps serving 30 days
regenerate the styles (gen-map-styles.mjs reads this lock)
refresh.cost_note: run outside GCP — a GCP-originated upload pays ~$17 egress per refresh (K1 §2.2, inference)
